description: Search the Project Gutenberg catalog of 78,000+ books. Every query word matches a title or author substring; filter by topic, language, translator, author lifespan, IDs, MIME prefix or copyright status. More than four query words, and the translator filter, require the local mirror. Empty matches succeed with criteria and a notice. Default popularity uses downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot. Returns IDs, titles, authors, languages, subjects, counts, and is_readable — use gutenberg_get_book for full metadata.

author_year_end.description: Include only books with an author who has a known birth or death year on or before this year. With author_year_start, one author must meet both bounds. Example: author_year_start=1800 with author_year_end=1899 returns books with 19th-century authors.

author_year_start.description: Include only books with an author who has a known birth or death year on or after this year (positive = CE, negative = BCE). With author_year_end, one author must meet both bounds.

copyright.description: Any selected source copyright status: "true" copyrighted, "false" public domain in the USA, "null" unknown. Empty means all statuses; this is not worldwide legal clearance.

ids.description: Narrow results to these Gutenberg IDs, intersected with other filters. An empty list selects nothing; omit for unrestricted IDs. Use gutenberg_get_book for full single-ID metadata.

languages.description: Filter to books in any of these catalog language codes, exactly as results report them ("en", not "eng"). Example: ["en"] for English, ["fr", "de"] for French or German, ["enm"] for Middle English.

mime_type.description: Literal prefix of a format MIME key, such as "text/plain" or "text/html". Blank means unset.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (1-indexed). Each page returns up to 32 books. Use totalCount to determine total pages.

query.description: Every nonblank whitespace-separated word must match title or author name as a case-insensitive literal substring. More than four words require the local mirror; live fallback rejects longer queries. Example: "dickens expectations" matches Great Expectations.

sort.description: Result ordering. "popular" (default) sorts by downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot, descending. "ascending" and "descending" sort by Gutenberg ID number.

topic.description: Case-insensitive phrase to match against subjects and bookshelves. Example: "detective" returns books on the "Detective and Mystery Stories" bookshelf. Separate from query — topic searches categorization metadata, not title/author.

translator.description: Every nonblank whitespace-separated word must match a translator name as a case-insensitive literal substring; words can land on different translators of one book, and accents must match. Requires the local mirror. Example: "maude" finds the Aylmer and Louise Maude translations. Result rows omit translators; gutenberg_get_book reports them.

name: gutenberg_search_books

books.description: Matching books, ordered by the sort parameter.

birth_year.description: Author birth year, or null if unknown.

death_year.description: Author death year, or null if unknown or still living.

download_count.description: Downloads in the last 30 days at the source snapshot.

has_plain_text.description: True for Text records with UTF-8 plain text; HTML-only editions can still have is_readable=true.

id.description: Gutenberg ID — pass to gutenberg_get_book for the full record or gutenberg_get_text to read the book.

is_readable.description: True for non-Sound records with UTF-8 plain text or HTML supported by gutenberg_get_text.

languages.description: Catalog language codes for this edition.

effectiveCriteria.description: Normalized search criteria, including sort and page defaults.

author_year_end.description: An author has a known birth or death year on or before this year (CE positive, BCE negative). With author_year_start, one author must meet both bounds.

author_year_start.description: An author has a known birth or death year on or after this year (CE positive, BCE negative). With author_year_end, one author must meet both bounds.

copyright.description: Any selected source copyright status: "true" copyrighted, "false" public domain in the USA, "null" unknown. Empty means all statuses; this is not worldwide legal clearance.

ids.description: Restrict to these Gutenberg IDs, intersected with other filters. An empty list selects nothing; omit for unrestricted IDs.

languages.description: Any listed two- or three-letter catalog language code; empty means all languages.

mime_type.description: Literal prefix of a format MIME key, such as "text/plain" or "text/html". Blank means unset.

page.description: One-indexed page of at most 32 matches. Pages beyond the result range are errors.

query.description: Every nonblank word must occur in the title or an author name, case-insensitively, as a literal substring. More than four words require the local mirror; live fallback rejects longer queries. Whitespace separates words.

sort.description: Popular orders by source-snapshot downloads in the last 30 days, with ID tie-breaks locally; ascending and descending order by Gutenberg ID.

topic.description: Case-insensitive phrase in a subject or bookshelf; blank means unset.

translator.description: Every nonblank word must occur in a translator name, case-insensitively, as a literal substring. Requires the local mirror. Whitespace separates words.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `translator_requires_mirror`: A translator filter was supplied while the local mirror could not answer. `query_requires_mirror`: More than four query words were supplied while the local mirror could not answer. `page_out_of_range`: The requested page number is past the last page of results for this query. `catalog_unavailable`: The Project Gutenberg catalog did not answer within the time this server allows for one search. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True if there are additional pages of results.

notice.description: Actionable guidance for an empty selection, or a caveat that the live catalog checked author_year_start and author_year_end separately. The caveat can accompany results.

totalCount.description: Total number of books matching the query across all pages.

title: Search Gutenberg Books
